evidence_interpretation.scientific_conclusion: The single v0.1 execution failed closed at the frozen wall-time cap before it produced admissible aggregate findings for the substantive source-role Gates. This is conclusive negative evidence about the feasibility of the v0.1 audit design under its frozen execution budget, but it is not evidence that the St.Gallen payload passed or failed schema, privacy, notice, protected-ground-truth exclusion, lineage, binding, pointer, semantic-fit, or LLM-increment Gates.
evidence_interpretation.disposition_basis: Hold the family at metadata-candidate level. Do not approve a source role and do not reject the underlying family solely from an infrastructure or algorithmic wall-time failure. Reject reuse, retry, resume, or cap-only rescue of the v0.1 audit path.

option_analysis.reason: The bounded execution produced no admissible aggregate evidence closing schema, privacy, notice, protected-ground-truth exclusion, lineage, binding, pointer, semantic-fit, or LLM-increment Gates.

The terminal reason was wall_time_cap_exceeded, not a detected protected-label, privacy, schema, notice, lineage, or pointer violation. Treating an inconclusive execution as a payload-safety failure would overstate the evidence.
Previously committed metadata establishes immutable identity, record-scope rights, and a curator-declared ten-execution direction, while the substantive source-role Gates remain entirely unclosed.
The authority allowed exactly one execution. The attempt is consumed on success or terminal failure, and both automatic retry and resume were explicitly forbidden.

A cap-only amendment would optimize the procedure after observing the terminal result without fixing or explaining the audit design. It would be a post hoc rescue rather than a new pre-registered method.

Any future attempt must be a new versioned experiment with a new contract, script identity, result paths, and one-time authority. The consumed authority and v0.1 result are immutable terminal evidence.

A future method may be considered only after an evidence-independent redesign establishes deterministic stage budgets and preserves or strengthens every safety Gate. This disposition neither drafts nor authorizes that method.
Immediate inactive downgrade is not required because the audit did not establish a substantive source defect. The candidate nevertheless occupies no portfolio slot and receives no credit while held.

forbidden_remediation: Retry, resume, restart, or relabel the consumed v0.1 execution as a fresh attempt.
Raise only maximum_wall_seconds or an equivalent timeout and rerun the same reader, parser, joins, probes, or result contract.
Reuse the v0.1 authority, script hash, contract status, result paths, or execution counter for a new attempt.
Delete, overwrite, weaken, reinterpret, or replace the committed terminal result.

Drop, narrow, whitelist, defer, sample away, or post-process privacy, notice, protected-label, ground-truth exclusion, schema, lineage, binding, pointer, or result-sanitization Gates to reduce runtime.
Read a smaller hand-selected row, field, time, process, activity, station, component, or sensor subset chosen after the timeout and treat it as equivalent to the frozen source role.
Expose the protected manifest, its identifiers, intervals, activities, states, timestamps, pointers, or derived supervision to a model.
Treat the curator-declared ten executions, acquisition identity, or timeout-free prefix as verified lineage or sample capacity.
Award family, lineage, sample, quota, source-role, train, development, pointer, or L2 credit from this hold.

required_pre_execution_evidence: A code-level root-cause analysis that does not reopen or inspect either source surface.
A redesigned pass structure with deterministic per-stage byte, record, node, and wall-time budgets.
Synthetic-fixture tests proving timeout handling, aggregate-only persistence, protected-manifest invisibility, and fail-closed behavior.
Proof that no privacy, notice, ground-truth, schema, lineage, binding, pointer, or sanitization Gate was removed, narrowed, deferred, or made sample-dependent.
A new authority that simultaneously names both targets and pins the new contract, script, reader, caps, and result paths.

replacement_slot.required_evidence_shape: A distinct endpoint or provenance family with at least four source-native label-independent execution, session, run, or capture groups and an evidence-safe surface that passes immutable rights, notice, protected-ground-truth, privacy, schema, lineage, binding, pointer, semantic-fit, and nuisance-independence Gates.

next_action: Keep St.Gallen on metadata-candidate hold, keep portfolio direction 04 vacant, and treat the v0.1 audit path as terminal. Do not retry, resume, or raise only the wall-time cap. Any future attempt requires a separately reviewed new method contract, new pinned script and result paths, new single-use authority, and a new explicit execute instruction.
